draft_en.subject: Industrial PoE switches for the Extralink range - who handles product sourcing?
draft_en.body:
Hello Batna24 team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the Extralink range we can build under your label from small lots: a DIN-rail industrial 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged switch, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS - model STI-288GP - $60 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); managed and 24-port commercial versions on the same basis. SFP optics and PoE power supplies we do not make.

One question: who handles Extralink product sourcing, so I send the specs to the right desk?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
